title: A Radiators for the Silence
author: Oscar Brightwater
blurb: Jonah Vasquez, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
